// The public API of @family-agenda/source-sdk, written by `pnpm sdk-api`. Do not edit it by hand.
// src/index.ts
export type PluginText = string | {
    en: string;
    [language: string]: string | undefined;
};
export declare function englishOf(text: PluginText): string;
export type SourcePluginIdentity = {
    sourceTypeId: string;
    displayName: PluginText;
    version: string;
    sdkVersion: string;
};
export type JsonValue = string | number | boolean | null | JsonValue[] | {
    [key: string]: JsonValue;
};
export type JsonObject = {
    [key: string]: JsonValue;
};
export type ConfigField = {
    key: string;
    label: PluginText;
    secret: boolean;
    required: boolean;
    description?: PluginText;
    setByPlugin?: boolean;
    choices?: (context: RunContext) => Promise<Choice[]>;
};
export type Choice = {
    value: string;
    label: string;
};
export type Catalogue = {
    title: PluginText;
    configKey: string;
    entries(): Promise<CatalogueEntry[]>;
};
export type CatalogueEntry = {
    id: string;
    displayName: PluginText;
    description: PluginText;
    installed: boolean;
    riskNotice?: PluginText;
};
export type Configuration = {
    version: number;
    fields: ConfigField[];
    migrations?: Record<number, (plain: JsonObject) => JsonObject>;
};
export type SetupStep = {
    id: string;
    title: PluginText;
    description: PluginText;
    progress?: (context: RunContext) => Promise<SetupProgress>;
};
export type SetupProgress = {
    status: "waiting";
    qrCode?: string;
    message?: PluginText;
} | {
    status: "done";
    message?: PluginText;
} | {
    status: "failed";
    message: PluginText;
};
export type RunContext = {
    config: {
        plain: JsonObject;
        secrets: Record<string, string>;
    };
    syncCursor: string | null;
    now: Date;
    timeZone: string;
};
export type SourceAttributeDeclaration = {
    externalId: string;
    name: string;
};
export interface SourceAttributes {
    declare(attributes: SourceAttributeDeclaration[]): Promise<void>;
    archive(externalId: string): Promise<void>;
}
export type IngestContext = RunContext & {
    attributes: SourceAttributes;
};
export type IngestResult = {
    origins: Origin[];
    syncCursor: string | null;
    withdrawn?: string[];
};
export type Ingestion = {
    mode: "polling";
    suggestedIntervalSeconds: number;
    poll(context: IngestContext): Promise<IngestResult>;
} | {
    mode: "push";
    receive(context: IngestContext, payload: Uint8Array): Promise<IngestResult>;
};
export type Attachment = {
    filename: string;
    contentType: string;
    bytes: Uint8Array;
};
export declare const statedKinds: readonly ["event", "lesson", "task"];
export declare const statedTextLimits: {
    readonly event: 500;
    readonly lesson: 200;
    readonly task: 500;
};
export declare function clipped(text: string, limit: number): string;
export type EventSpan = {
    allDay: false;
    start: string;
    end: string;
} | {
    allDay: true;
    firstDay: string;
    lastDay: string;
};
export type StatedEvent = {
    kind: "event";
    title: string;
    span: EventSpan;
    place: string | null;
    cancelled: boolean;
};
export type LessonSpan = {
    allDay: false;
    start: string;
    end: string;
};
export type StatedLesson = {
    kind: "lesson";
    subject: string;
    span: LessonSpan;
    room: string | null;
    teacher: string | null;
    change: "cancellation" | "substitution" | "room-change" | null;
    previousRoom: string | null;
    previousTeacher: string | null;
    note: string | null;
};
export type StatedTask = {
    kind: "task";
    title: string;
    deadline: string | null;
    bring: string[];
};
export type StatedItem = StatedEvent | StatedLesson | StatedTask;
export type Origin = {
    externalId: string;
    occurredAt?: Date;
    attributes: string[];
    sender?: string;
    subject?: string;
    link?: string;
    content: {
        kind: "raw-message";
        text: string;
        attachments: Attachment[];
    } | {
        kind: "stated";
        stated: StatedItem;
    };
};
export type Health = {
    silentApplies: boolean;
};
export declare class SourceError extends Error {
    readonly kind: "definite" | "temporary";
    constructor(message: string, kind: "definite" | "temporary");
    static definite(message: string): SourceError;
    static temporary(message: string): SourceError;
}
export type Services = {
    reconcile(enabled: {
        enabled: boolean;
        entries: string[];
    }): Promise<void>;
    stop(): Promise<void>;
};
export interface SourcePlugin {
    identity: SourcePluginIdentity;
    configuration: Configuration;
    setupSteps: SetupStep[];
    ingestion: Ingestion;
    health: Health;
    catalogue?: Catalogue;
    services?: Services;
    sourceAdded?(context: Omit<RunContext, "syncCursor">): Promise<{
        plain: JsonObject;
        secrets: Record<string, string>;
    }>;
    sourceRemoved?(context: RunContext): Promise<void>;
}
export declare function problemsWith(plugin: SourcePlugin): string[];
export declare function problemsWithOrigin(origin: Origin): string[];
export type SourcePluginManifest = {
    entry: string;
    identity: SourcePluginIdentity;
    description: PluginText;
    needsLlm: boolean;
    riskNotice?: PluginText;
    esModule: boolean;
};
export type ManifestResult = {
    ok: true;
    manifest: SourcePluginManifest;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "no-manifest";
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "invalid-manifest";
    sourceTypeId?: string;
    details: string[];
};
export declare function parseManifest(packageJson: unknown): ManifestResult;
export declare function problemsWithManifest(manifest: SourcePluginManifest): string[];
// src/testing.ts
import { type RunContext, type SourceAttributes, type SourcePlugin } from "./index";
export type ContractOptions = {
    config?: RunContext["config"];
    now?: Date;
    languages?: string[];
    packageJson?: unknown;
};
export declare function recordingAttributes(): SourceAttributes & {
    active(): string[];
    names(): Record<string, string>;
};
export declare function undeclaredAttributes(plugin: SourcePlugin, config: RunContext["config"], now?: Date): Promise<string[]>;
export declare function describeSourcePluginContract(createPlugin: () => SourcePlugin, options?: ContractOptions): void;
